<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="description" content="Chanell Brosas Tapsilogan — delicious Filipino silog meals for only ₱99 in Herbosa Street, Tondo, Manila.">
<title>Chanell Brosas Tapsilogan | Silog Meals ₱99</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#101110;--panel:#191a18;--gold:#ffbd27;--gold2:#f5a900;--text:#fffaf0;--muted:#c9c4b8;--line:#4b3512}
*{box-sizing:border-box} html{scroll-behavior:smooth} body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none} .wrap{width:min(1180px,92%);margin:auto}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(15,16,15,.96);border-bottom:1px solid #28251e;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.nav{min-height:82px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:22px}
.brand{font-weight:900;color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2.5vw,2rem);font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1.05}
.brand small{display:block;color:white;font-size:.55em;letter-spacing:.28em;font-style:normal;text-align:center;margin-top:5px}
nav{display:flex;gap:clamp(14px,3vw,34px);align-items:center;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem} nav a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--gold);color:#16130b;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;transition:.2s;border:0;cursor:pointer} .btn:hover{background:#ffd46b;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.hero{min-height:440px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center;gap:20px;padding:45px 0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%,#41230d 0,transparent 48%)}
.hero-copy h1{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5.4vw,5rem);line-height:.95;margin:0;color:var(--gold);font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-2px;text-shadow:0 4px 20px #000}
.hero-copy h1 span{display:block;color:white;font-size:.38em;letter-spacing:.25em;font-style:normal;margin-top:15px}
.tagline{font-size:1.25rem;font-style:italic;margin:20px 0;color:#f4e8d0}
.hero-details{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;margin:24px 0;color:#f3eee3} .hero-details span{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center} .icon{color:var(--gold);font-size:1.35rem}
.hero-photo{width:100%;height:350px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #72501c;box-shadow:0 18px 45px #0009}
.section-head{text-align:center;margin:16px 0 28px} .section-head h2{color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.5rem);font-style:italic;margin:0} .section-head p{color:var(--muted);margin:5px 0}
.price-banner{display:inline-block;background:var(--gold);color:#17130a;font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:900;padding:5px 26px;border-radius:8px;transform:rotate(-1deg);margin-top:10px}
.menu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;padding-bottom:56px}
.menu-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s} .menu-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--gold)}
.menu-card img{display:block;width:100%;height:165px;object-fit:cover} .card-info{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:12px}
.card-info h3{margin:0;font-size:1rem} .card-info p{font-size:.77rem;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 0}
.price{white-space:nowrap;background:var(--gold);color:#15120a;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:900}
.about{background:#171815;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:48px 0}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:center} .about h2{color:var(--gold);font-size:2.2rem;margin:0 0 10px} .about p{color:var(--muted)}
.contact-list{display:grid;gap:16px} .contact-item{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start} .contact-item strong{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:.9rem} .contact-item a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.hours{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #55401c;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 18px;margin-top:10px}
footer{padding:20px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem} .footer-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:850px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:36px 0}.hero-photo{height:290px;grid-row:1}.menu-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr} nav{gap:12px} nav .btn{display:none}}
@media(max-width:520px){.nav{min-height:72px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 0}nav{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.82rem;padding-bottom:4px}.hero-copy h1{font-size:3rem}.menu-grid{gap:10px}.menu-card img{height:130px}.card-info{padding:9px;align-items:flex-start}.card-info h3{font-size:.9rem}.card-info p{display:none}.price{font-size:.85rem;padding:5px 8px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div><h2>Good Food. Sulit Presyo.</h2><p>Drop by Chanell Brosas Tapsilogan for comforting Filipino silog favorites.
